description: Programmatic output validators. AIToolPage now runs tool-specific rules after every successful generation and surfaces failures as a yellow banner with a one-click Auto-fix button that re-prompts the AI with the specific failure. SmartTargets must contain a number + frequency word + date phrase per target; ReportComments enforces word count within ±25% and bans common clichés; ExitTicket must contain the teacher answer-key separator; BehaviourPlan must include at least 10 numbered sections.
steps: Create client/src/lib/output-validators.ts with a Validator function shape, per-tool rule functions, and a TOOL_VALIDATORS registry keyed by tool slug.

Implement smartTargetsValidator (per-target measurable + time-bound checks), reportCommentsValidator (±25% word count + cliché blacklist), exitTicketValidator (separator presence), behaviourPlanValidator (≥10 numbered sections), and a generic minimumLengthValidator.
In AIToolPage, run runValidators(toolSlug, output, values) on every successful generation, every Auto-fix, and every section-regenerate.
Render a yellow banner above the output card listing up to five issues with severity-aware colours.
Add an Auto-fix button that calls AI with the validation's autoFixInstruction and re-runs the validators.
Add a dismiss button on the banner.
acceptance_criteria: Tools without registered validators see no UI change.
Tools with validators show a banner only when issues are detected.
Auto-fix updates the output in place and re-runs validators.
Auto-fix output is also pushed into history (so the teacher can revert).
verification: Manual: SmartTargets — generate without 'by [date]' phrasing, verify time-bound issue surfaces, click Auto-fix.
findings: Validator rules are intentionally lenient (warn rather than error) so a SENCO can ship a usable output even when one criterion is missing. Auto-fix instructions are concatenated when multiple rules fail.
